mu_name_from: MODEL_SYLPH_WIND_BOW (MODEL_BOW + 21), loaded from Item/HDK_Bow.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1098). Group 4 number 21 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs.
why_this_one: Kanturu's level-380 weapons (the user, 2026-10-22: 'lets now cook kanturu weapons and armors'), every class's but the Dark Lord's (the Soleil Scepter, HDK_Mace, left out); dormant until Kanturu drops them.

stats.call_note: The Season 6 CreateWeapon: group, number, slot, skill, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strength, agility, energy, vitality, then darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel.
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Drops in Kanturu only (the user, 2026-10-25: "The 380 gear", "Kanturu only"): sim::kanturuGear keeps anything asking level 380 to the maps whose rules drop kanturu_gear. Its drop level is MU's.
stats.requires_note: MU asks level 380 (OpenMU's levelRequirement), and so does ours (the user, 2026-10-25: "Level 380"): found in the Ruins from 320, worn from 380. The stat columns are raw, scaled by the drop level as every item's.
stats.class_level_note: The Muse Elf's alone: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).
